summary.text: Lilli Walsh is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 15 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
She is a business owner and former purchasing and procurement professional who lives in Hampstead.

paragraphs.text: Lilli Walsh lives in Hampstead, New Hampshire, and earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from Southern New Hampshire University in 1995.

Her career experience includes owning Technology Sales, Inc. and working as one of its sales managers, as a commodity manager and procurement specialist with Hewlett-Packard Laboratories, and as a senior purchasing agent with Wang Laboratories, Inc.

Walsh has served as vice chair of the Rockingham County Republican Committee, as community engagement director of the New Hampshire Federation of Republican Women, and on the Hampstead Budget Committee.
Ballotpedia lists her House tenure as beginning in 2022 and shows a general-election win in Rockingham 15 in 2024.
